read2（）;“热！热！热！”
这是林无缺此刻唯一的感觉。
一座朴素简洁的小屋内，林无缺艰难维持着盘坐的姿势，浑身滚烫，原本白皙的皮肤早已变得通红！
豆大的汗珠不停的流淌，但顷刻间却都被温度高到吓人的体温极速蒸发。
双目紧闭，眉头微蹙，虽然面无表情，可从那紧紧咬住的腮帮不难看出此时的林无缺似乎正在忍受极大的痛楚。
“嗡”
“哗啦啦”
道道犹如江河澎湃的轰鸣声从林无缺的体内传出，如果细细看去，便会发现林无缺体表每一寸皮肤都在轻轻的蠕动！
仿佛，在他的体内，正有一股沛然莫御的力量肆意奔腾！
血肉好像被蛮力疯狂撕扯！
神魂似乎被寒刃不停卷刮！
虽然两种巨大的痛苦不断侵袭着林无缺的神经，但十年来早已被打磨透亮的意志却让这个不过十五岁的少年硬是苦苦的坚持着！
且在这痛苦之下，林无缺依旧保持着清醒的意识。
“我的身体....似乎正在发生着巨大的变化！这变化、正是我寂灭十年所换来的....圣法本源！”
“咚咚咚”
如同闷雷从体内轰然炸响，盘坐着的林无缺身躯骤然摇晃，随之而来的却是剧烈的颤抖，体表原本细小的蠕动幅度也在这一刻陡增数倍！
痛苦！
深入骨髓、深入神魂的痛苦刹那间淹没了林无缺的神经，他仿佛感觉到自己置身在十座喷发的火山中心一般！
燃烧、撕扯、卷刮.......种种比之先前更胜数倍、不能言表的痛楚齐齐袭来，纵使意志强如林无缺，在这一刻也几乎无法忍受。

肉身的感知慢慢麻木，清醒的意识渐渐模糊。
似乎在下一刹，林无缺就将彻底昏死过去，再也醒不过来。
“给我守住！给我守住啊！不能昏过去！一定不能昏过去！”
无声的厉啸在心中响起，汗水早已打湿了他周身各处，眼前虽然漆黑一片，耳边轰鸣不断，犹如潮水般强烈的痛苦肆掠着他的神经！
一个呼吸恰似永恒，林无缺几欲成狂！
“轰隆隆”
“哗啦啦”
江河湖海轰鸣的澎湃声更猛烈三分，体表的肌肉已经虬结，体内粗大的筋脉暴突，像一条条狰狞的大蛇清晰可见。
痛苦达到了极致！
忍耐也达到了极限！
但林无缺依然死死地熬着！
纵然是死，也绝不放弃！
没有人知道，这个少年心中的执念是如何的可怕，看似坚韧、不屈，其实，那已经是一种近似于疯狂的偏执。
“唉”
就在这生死存亡的关头，一道来自林无缺脑海深处的叹息轻轻响起，这叹息似乎夹杂一股渗透万古的寂寞，又带着一丝仿佛从沉睡中被唤醒的迷茫。
“嗡”
盘坐着的林无缺脑后一道金芒一闪而逝。
意识已经干涸模糊的林无缺在这一刻突然感觉到一股清凉，好像是干旱皲裂的大地再度得到了来自天降甘霖的滋润。
“嗡”
模糊的意识在这骤然出现的清凉之下再度清醒了过来，原本眼前漆黑，只能凭借感知的林无缺忽然感觉一亮，接着一切大变！

read2(); "Hot! Hot! Hot!"
This was Lin Wuque's only feeling at the moment.
In a simple and simple hut, Lin Wuque struggled to maintain a cross-legged posture. His whole body was burning hot, and his originally fair skin had already turned red!
The big beads of sweat kept flowing, but in an instant they were evaporated by the frighteningly high body temperature.
His eyes were closed and his brows were slightly furrowed. Although his face was expressionless, it was easy to tell from the tightly bitten cheeks that Lin Wuque seemed to be enduring great pain at this time.
"Buzz"
"Wow!"
A roar like a surging river came from Lin Wuque's body. If you look carefully, you will find that every inch of Lin Wuque's skin is squirming gently!
It was as if, within his body, there was an unstoppable force running wildly!
The flesh and blood seemed to be torn apart crazily by brute force!
The soul seems to be constantly being scraped by the cold blade!
Although two kinds of huge pains were constantly attacking Lin Wuque's nerves, the willpower that had been polished for ten years allowed this boy who was only fifteen years old to persevere!
And under this pain, Lin Wuque still maintained a clear consciousness.
"My body... seems to be undergoing huge changes! This change is exactly what I have gained after ten years of silence... the origin of the holy law!"
"Dong dong dong"
Like a muffled thunder exploding from the body, Lin Wuque's body suddenly shook while sitting cross-legged, followed by violent trembling, and the originally small squirming amplitude on the body surface also increased several times at this moment!
pain!
The pain that penetrated deep into his bones and soul instantly overwhelmed Lin Wuque's nerves. He felt as if he was in the center of ten erupting volcanoes!
Burning, tearing, scraping... all kinds of indescribable pain that was several times worse than before came all at once. Even if his will was as strong as Lin Wuque's, he could hardly bear it at this moment.
The physical sensation gradually becomes numb, and the conscious consciousness gradually becomes blurred.
It seemed that in the next moment, Lin Wuque would completely faint and never wake up again.
"Hold it to me! Hold it to me! Don't faint! You mustn't faint!"
A silent scream resounded in his heart, and sweat had already wet all parts of his body. Although his eyes were pitch black and his ears were constantly ringing, intense pain like a tide was raging through his nerves!
One breath seemed like eternity, and Lin Wuque almost went crazy with desire!
"Rumble"
"Wow!"
The roaring sounds of the rivers, lakes and seas were three times more violent. The muscles on the surface of the body had become knotted, and the thick tendons in the body protruded, clearly visible like ferocious snakes.
The pain reached the extreme!
My patience has reached its limit!
But Lin Wuque was still holding on!
Even if you die, never give up!
No one knows how terrifying the obsession in this young man's heart is. It seems tough and unyielding, but in fact, it is already a kind of paranoia that is close to madness.
"Alas"
At this critical moment of life and death, a sigh sounded softly from the depths of Lin Wuque's mind. This sigh seemed to be mixed with a loneliness that penetrated through the ages, and a trace of confusion as if he had been awakened from a deep sleep.
"Buzz"
A golden light flashed behind Lin Wuque's head, who was sitting cross-legged.
Lin Wuque, whose consciousness had become dry and blurred, suddenly felt a coolness at this moment, as if the dry and cracked earth was once again nourished by the rain from the sky.
"Buzz"
The vague consciousness came to consciousness again under the sudden coolness. Lin Wuque's eyes were originally dark, and he could only rely on his perception. Suddenly, he felt a light, and then everything changed drastically!
